blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte has not declared any cash on hand and in bank from the years 2019 to 2025 in her Statements of Assets Liabilities and Net Worth (SALNs), a prosecution witness said Tuesday. Officer-in-Charge of the Records Division from the Ombudsman’s office lawyer Karen Batu said this before the Senate
